label: WEF 2025 global employer skill expectations — TEAM-MAPPED MODEL SIGNAL (not Malaysian observed demand)

limitations: WEF findings are global employer expectations, not Malaysian observed hiring or a time series of actual skill demand.
Semantic mappings to SkillShift skill IDs are interpretations, not source-defined skill identifiers.
1.05 is a team-chosen model sensitivity factor, not measured growth or a calibrated forecast.
Changes in readiness are weighted skill overlap, not job-employment probabilities.
Single-edition snapshot is refreshable but not an automatically updated or measured longitudinal trend.
